subject: RM_Emberscythe
departures: ember-dark chitin, charcoal-black with smouldering ember-red tones, never the green or brown of an Earth mantis
large, heavy body far beyond insect scale, clearly a big predator against the ash ground
thick, armoured shell plating instead of a thin, leaf-like or twig-like mantis body
forelimbs that end in long single scythe blades with a cutting edge, not the spined grasping forelegs of an Earth mantis
crouched low in grey ash, its body partly dusted or half-buried in it
